messages:
Maria L.: Hey team — quick heads up, I had a flare-up with lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow) over the weekend. Doc suggested more frequent short breaks and avoiding repetitive wrist movements. I wanted to request a short-term adjustment: reduce on-call finger-intensive tasks (i.e., keyboard-heavy remediation) and shift to review/triage work where possible for ~6 weeks. Open to a convo about coverage.
Sam - Eng Mgr: Thanks for flagging, Maria. Totally okay — can we hop on a quick sync today? want to understand which parts of oncall are most painful so we can reassign. no judgement. :heart:
Amelia (People Ops): Hi Maria — thanks for sharing. We can support a temporary duty reassignment under our accommodation process. Two practical next steps: 1) if you're comfortable, send a brief medical note (can be short, confirm limitation and approximate duration) to people-ops@redwood.com; 2) we'll draft a temporary coverage plan and keep details private. I'm happy to draft language for the team.
Jake T.: I can swap a couple of my oncall windows. send me the dates and I'll mark them in PagerDuty. :thumbsup:
Maria L.: Appreciate it, Jake. Example of what feels bad: long incident remediation with lots of repeated typing and long terminal sessions. Quick triage, runbooks, and pair-debugging are OK.
Sam - Eng Mgr: Noted. Maria, would you be okay with reduced oncall keyboard tasks but still appear to triage via calls/screenshare? We can route keyboard-heavy pages to a "keyboard" buddy.
Maria L.: Yep that sounds good. Prefer pairing or taking incident lead for coordination only. I can do paged coordination and post-incident writeups.
Amelia (People Ops): Drafting a 6-week plan now. We typically ask for a short note (email or PDF) that states the functional limitation and suggested duration — no detailed diagnosis required if you prefer. We'll also coordinate with Eng to identify coverage rotation. I'll create a private Google doc for the plan and share with Sam and you only.
HR Bot: Reminder: Do not post medical documentation in public channels. Share via private email to people-ops@redwood.com or a 1:1 DM.
Maria L.: Thanks — I'll email a short note from my physio today. Also wondering about ergonomics support — can we get a loaner vertical mouse and a short ergonomic consult?
Amelia (People Ops): Yes — we can ship a vertical mouse and set up a 20-min consult with our ergonomics vendor. I'll include that in the doc and put a 1-week timeline for shipping.
Sam - Eng Mgr: For coverage: Jake — can you take 2-3 of Maria's oncall windows next two weeks? I'll redistribute the rest among the team.
Jake T.: yep, I put a hold on the two windows. send shift details and i'm good.
Maria L.: I updated my calendar with tentative reduced-duty dates:
```
Week 1-2: no keyboard remediation oncall nights (cover via buddy)
Week 3-6: gradual return to full oncall as tolerated
```
I'll DM Amelia when the note is sent. Thanks everyone — feeling relieved.
Amelia (People Ops): Perfect. I'll follow up with the private doc + next steps (shipping, lodging coverage, and HR confirmation). We'll treat this as temporary accommodation with a check-in at 3 weeks.
Maria L.: Sounds good. Appreciate the quick responses.
Sam - Eng Mgr: Thanks all. We'll keep things confidential and make the swap smooth.
HR Bot: Logged accommodation inquiry (internal ID: AC-2026-142). A People Ops rep will follow up within 2 business days.
